BrochureContent.Content:
Michael Pigott Auctioneer & Valuer proudly offers for sale an exceptional contemporary residence in a prime countryside setting near Minane Bridge.

Occupying a nicely elevated 0.86-acre site in a peaceful countryside setting, this outstanding detached residence offers the perfect balance of luxury, privacy, and convenience, just minutes walk from the vibrant village of Minane Bridge and within easy reach of Cork City, Cork Airport, and the beautiful South Coast.

Designed with modern family living in mind, the home extends to generous proportions and has been finished to an exceptional standard throughout. Bright, light-filled interiors and a thoughtfully designed layout create a seamless flow between the elegant reception rooms and the heart of the home, providing superb spaces for both everyday living and entertaining.

The accommodation comprises five spacious bedrooms and four beautifully appointed bathrooms, complemented by an abundance of versatile living space to suit the needs of a growing family.

Outside, the landscaped grounds enjoy an enviable elevated position, offering privacy and picturesque countryside views. The outdoor rondo provides a unique focal point and an idyllic space for outdoor entertaining, summer dining, or simply relaxing while enjoying the peaceful surroundings.

It is ideally located, just a mere 10 minutes drive to Carrigaline, and only a short commute to Cork City Centre, Cork Airport & Ringaskiddy. It is also minutes to all local beaches such as Roberts Cove, Rocky Bay, Oysterhaven and Fountainstown.

Viewing of this wonderful family home in an idyllic setting comes highly recommended.

Size: 258 sq metres (2,774 sq ft)
Private 0.86 acre site
Oil Fired Central Heating with solar panels for hot water
Woodgrain PVC Windows
Spacious living & bedroom accommodation
Superb decorative order throughout 
Newly installed fitted kitchen with integrated appliances
Newly refurbished bathrooms
Detached garage
Secure automated Intercom gate system
Outdoor Rondo rotating pavilion
Fully alarmed
Short drive to a selection of local beaches such as Roberts Cove & Rocky Bay
Beautiful rural location
10 minute drive to Carrigaline
Short commute to Cork City Centre & Cork Airport

Services: Private bored well water supply, private bio-cycle unit on site, High Speed Fibre Broadband Network Connection, Mains electricity

On entering Carrigaline via the Shannon Park roundabout, continue straight through the next two roundabouts. Go straight ahead on the main street and follow the road as it curves to the right, past ‘The Corner House’. Continue on straight out the Lower Kilmoney road, driving for approximately 3 miles. Follow Eircode: P17 TX65
